## Summary

What does this change do, and why? (~1-3 sentences)

## Related issue

Related to #...

Use `Closes #...` only when this pull request completes the linked issue.

## Test plan

State the observable result and how it was verified. Attach screenshots, console output, measurements, or reproduction steps when the outcome requires them.

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows existing patterns and conventions
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes
- [ ] `pnpm lint` is clean
- [ ] `pnpm knip` is clean
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` is clean
- [ ] `pnpm test` is clean
- [ ] Review findings were repaired and the exact head was re-reviewed
- [ ] Commit history is clean and follows conventional commits
